scope: Independent exact replacement encoded visual/narration review. Editorial POST leaves continuous soundwatch, human watch, Apple decode and publication gates separate.

lessons.reason: The exact replacement earns POST through stable geometric counterexamples, actual byte/codebook and lookup constructions, retained graph candidates and a held new-query ending. Both prior material findings are resolved in the immutable MP4. All24authored scene sheets plus brand remain personally inspected:22authored sheets and brand are SHA-identical to prior views, while both changed sheets and five changed registered natives were freshly viewed. Twelve additional exact native extractions verify calibration failure/repair and result-complete reveal boundaries. The brief .4125second coarse-tie hold and later settled operational recaps retain honest craft deductions.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The origin, query and A/B endpoints establish separate direction and magnitude on equal-unit axes.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The populated geometric state holds through much of the descriptive narration; later metric scenes supply the active comparisons.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same arrows receive cosine and straight-line gaps, then the raw dot contributions remain alongside them.

reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Current norms distinguish the transient contraction from the settled unit-vector reference.

reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Three separate failure/numerical/ranking states avoid equating a numerical safeguard with authorization.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Nested prefix-loss widths lead into actual audit/rotation/lifecycle rows; cutting the suffix creates a tie and drops recall2/2→1/2.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The actual close candidate endpoints move to the0.2grid and their recomputed cosines become equal.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: A scalar moves to its reconstruction point; real byte bits, a range-offset interval and fixed-query constant removal follow.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Stored code, offset and reconstructed numeric meanings remain distinct.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The same encoded A/B rows reverse their raw-code winner when dimension scales are restored; reconstructed norms then distinguish cosine.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The numeric failure and repair use identical code identities.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: The ordinary MAE/outlier audit is followed by a separate actual normalized-row reconstruction. Coarse25collides both rows and picks A by tie; fine1recovers B.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The distinct collision and finer repair are now actually drawn and independently verified. The completed coarse tie has only .4125seconds before the next construction; a longer dwell is a worthwhile craft improvement, not an unresolved correctness blocker.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Exact16-bit sums expose high bits; narrow2/4results differ from widening operands before multiplication.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The lost-high-bit construction separates rounding from arithmetic overflow.

reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The random-hyperplane expectation is explicitly separated from the original fixed axes.
